title: An effaceable delta-functor is universal (Grothendieck)
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] and $F=(F^n,\delta_F)$ a $\delta$-functor from $\mathcal A$ to $\mathcal B$ [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor]. Suppose that for every $n>0$ and every object $A$ of $\mathcal A$ there is a monomorphism $u:A\to B$ (depending on $A$ and $n$) such that $F^n(u):F^n(A)\to F^n(B)$ is zero. Then $F$ is a universal $\delta$-functor [def-weil-pbc-delta-functor]: for every $\delta$-functor $G=(G^n,\delta_G)$ from $\mathcal A$ to $\mathcal B$ and every natural transformation $t:F^0\to G^0$ there is a unique morphism of $\delta$-functors $(t^n)_{n\ge0}:F\to G$ with $t^0=t$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 010T (lemma-efface-implies-universal), with its proof (induction on n through the cokernel description F^{n+1}(A)=Coker(F^n(B)->F^n(C)); the verification that t^{n+1} is a natural transformation is 'omitted' in Stacks and must be written out at the split)

proof.text: Starting at t in degree zero, use the successor construction recursively (Nat.rec and Classical.choose). The successor compatibility packages these transformations as a morphism of delta-functors. For any other extension, induct on degree; choose an effacing embedding and its cokernel sequence. Exactness and vanishing imply that its connecting map is epi. Compatibility and equality in the preceding degree imply equality after precomposition with that epi, hence equality of components. Function extensionality and proof irrelevance give equality of morphisms.
